content: साक्षात् {%ind.%} .²1 In the presence of, before the very eyes, visibly, openly, evidently. .²2 In person, actually in bodily form; साक्षात् प्रियामुपगतामपहाय पूर्वम् <ls>Ś. 6. 15</ls>, <ls n="Ś.">1. 6</ls>. .²3 Directly. In <ab>comp.</ab> it is often translated by ‘incarnate’; साक्षाद्यमः; or by ‘open, direct’; तत्साक्षात् प्रतिषेधः कोपाय <ls>Māl. 1. 11</ls>. (साक्षात्कृ .²1 to see with oneʼs own eyes, realize personally. .²2 to have an intuitive perception or manifestation of; साक्षात्कृतधमर्ण ऋषयः <ls>U. 7</ls>. .²3 To experience a result of or reward for; साक्षात्कृतं मे परिबर्हणं हि <ls>Bhāg. 5. 5. 27</ls>, <ls n="Bhāg.">10. 22. 20.</ls>)
